work_experience.role: React.js, Redux Toolkit, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, JWT, Cloudinary
responsibilities: Engineered 19 RESTful API endpoints in Node.js/Express.js to power job listings, search/filter, and one-click application workflows, tested against a dataset of 50–100 sample users and job postings.

Implemented JWT authentication and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) across all endpoints, enforcing distinct permission boundaries for job seekers and recruiters and eliminating unauthorized cross-role data access.

Built a recruiter dashboard for job post management and applicant tracking; integrated the Cloudinary API for resume and profile image uploads, cutting manual file-handling steps in the application flow.
Designed a fully responsive UI with React.js, Redux Toolkit, Tailwind CSS, and ShadCN UI; wrote 24 tests covering API routes and component behavior to catch regressions before deployment.

work_experience.role: Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, EJS, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript
responsibilities: Built a full-stack blogging platform with complete CRUD functionality, structuring REST API routes and MongoDB schemas that scaled to 50+ blog entries while maintaining consistent data integrity.
Implemented server-side rendering with EJS to reduce client-side load and improve initial page-load performance.
Designed a responsive UI verified across desktop and mobile viewports, ensuring consistent layout and usability across screen sizes.

Secured 2nd position (final semester), Diploma in Petrochemical Engineering, CIPET Hajipur (2022).
